description: Classified transactions for a Nimiq address, newest first. Read-only: never signs, never sends. Each row carries the kind the NimBooks app shows (payment, stake, unstake, reward, swap, vesting), the counterparty, and the memo — a cashlink’s protocol tag reads as "Cashlink" rather than raw bytes, and a `nimbooks:invoice:<id>` memo is the reference that ties a payment to a request.

address.description: Nimiq address (NQ form, spaced or flat, or 40 hex characters). Optional; defaults to the server’s configured address.

since.description: Only transactions at or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601, UTC).

until.description: Only transactions at or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601, UTC).

name: list_transactions
title: List transactions
